test_case.test_name: Leaky sensor line — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Validate the exact leak-detection line asserts the mapped sensor/alarm and approved protective response under a controlled wet stimulus, then deasserts and restores normal operation after verified safe drying.
required_package: Leak-line zone/channel and BMC sensor/SEL mapping
Vendor-approved simulator/test fluid, amount, location, dwell and containment
Expected warning/error, action, shutdown-or-other timing and deassert behavior
Dryness verification, electrical isolation, abort, re-energization and recovery procedure
test_case.test_command: Map line/zone/channel and sensor/SEL; isolate dedicated system with containment; qualified operator applies only a vendor-approved simulator or specified test fluid at defined quantity/location/dwell while agent records synchronized telemetry; verify alarm/action timing; remove stimulus and use approved non-damaging drying; independently confirm dryness, deassertion and recovery before re-energization/final state.
test_case.expected_result: 1. Leaky sensor should record a warning or error message. 2. System should have correct behavior ex: shutdown in 1 min. 3. Sensor should recover after leaky sensor line detection is dry.
